'''Eeginny''' was a half-wind-spirit princess in [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] mythology who could walk on the leaves of trees. "Eeginny" was a popular name for female [[Wokling/Legends|Ewok children]].<ref name="GCG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Eeginny was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Campaign Guide]]'', a [[2003]] supplement for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]'' that was written by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]] and [[J.D. Wiker]].<ref name="GCG" />
